for (const { level = 1 } of [{ level: 2 }, {}] as const) {
  const allowed: 1 | 2 = level;
  console.log(allowed);
}
for (const [first] of [[1, 'one']] as const) {
  const one: 1 = first;
  console.log(one);
}
for (const { level = 1 } of [{}]) {
  const one: 1 = level;
  console.log(one);
}
for (const { start, stop } of [{ start: 1 }, { stop: 2 }]) console.log(start, stop);

const flag = Boolean(console.log);
for (const { level = 1 } of flag ? [{ level: 2 }] as const : [{}]) {
  const allowed: 1 | 2 = level;
  console.log(allowed);
}
for (const [{ level = 1 }] of flag ? [[{ level: 2 }]] : [[{}]]) {
  const wide: number = level;
  console.log(wide);
}
for (const [{ level = 1 }] of flag ? [[{ level: 2 }]] as const : [[{}]] as const) {
  const allowed: 1 | 2 = level;
  console.log(allowed);
}
for (const { nested: { level = 1 } } of flag ? [{ nested: { level: 2 } }] : [{ nested: {} }]) {
  const wide: number = level;
  console.log(wide);
}
